item.title: Rolls-Royce Phantom Arabesque: World’s first laser-engraved bonnet
item.description: LONDON: The one-of-one Rolls-Royce Phantom Arabesque explores Middle Eastern architectural heritage through a newly patented laser-engraving technique. This one-of-one Phantom Extended celebrates the forms and geometry of traditional mashrabiya latticework – a defining feature of traditional houses, palaces and courtyards throughout the Middle East.
